subagents.max_depth.label: Max Depth
subagents.max_depth.help: Maximum hierarchical depth that subagents can recursively delegate to other subagents.

subagents.launch_concurrency.label: Launch Concurrency
subagents.launch_concurrency.help: How many subagents to launch simultaneously in one turn before queuing the rest. Prevents instant burst from causing API rate limiting.

subagents.max_admitted.label: Max Admitted
subagents.max_admitted.help: Total number of subagents including running and queued. High fan-out tasks can be queued, but runtime launch pressure is controlled.

subagents.worker_model.label: Worker Model
subagents.worker_model.help: Subagent model for executing specific coding/modification tasks.

subagents.explorer_model.label: Explorer Model
subagents.explorer_model.help: Subagent model for exploring codebase and searching files.

subagents.awaiter_model.label: Awaiter Model
subagents.awaiter_model.help: Subagent model for waiting for external events and polling results.

subagents.review_model.label: Review Model
subagents.review_model.help: Subagent model for code review and result verification.
